summary: Recent updates to the testing framework in Firefox have strengthened the reliability and performance of audio and video encoding features. New tests have been added to ensure that the audio encoder properly handles various input sizes, rejecting overly large resampled outputs, which is crucial for maintaining quality. Additionally, there are improvements in testing the H.264 video codec, particularly involving the WebRTC technology used for real-time communications, by validating the stripping of auxiliary data and sharing checks across different tests. These enhancements help ensure that Firefox can effectively manage high-quality media playback and encoding, contributing to an overall better user experience when streaming and creating audio and video content. **Test consistency in handling 4K video and audio streams during seeking** is particularly significant as users increasingly demand high-definition content with seamless playback.
